verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports testing apart from production. The as-code CLI can "manage multiple environments" and suits "CI/CD pipelines, local development" with automated testing. Loki can also be run locally on a filesystem backend for experimentation, and a free tier exists for exploring ideas. None of this is a dedicated sandbox, so isolating test work from production data is a do-it-yourself setup rather than a documented product capability. Missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox or test environment, guarantees that test work is isolated from production data, an agent- or MCP-specific sandbox mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
